name: localeditor
description: Read and edit local documents, create Mermaid diagrams, compose Canvas boards and sketches with local images, and build Pages in approved LocalEditor Projects and Scratchpads.

interface.longDescription: Create Mermaid diagrams in Markdown, compose editable Canvas wireframes and reference boards with local images, and build Pages with images and linked subpages in LocalEditor on macOS. Explicit format choices and existing files are preserved. Work in Projects and Scratchpads approved through Agent Access; files stay local.
defaultPrompt: Read the design brief in my LocalEditor Project before you start.
Put the test steps for this change in a LocalEditor Scratchpad.
Read my notes on the checklist and fix what failed.
